Have you ever wanted to take your C.A.M.P. Pet out into the wasteland to travel and fight alongside you? We hope so, because we’re relaxing the leash on pets so that they can join you on your adventures!

Today we’re kicking off a very special Public Test Server (henceforth known as a Pspsps-TS or Paw-TS if you're so inclined) for a major new feature coming to Fallout 76 later this year.

### How to Participate in the PTS

All players who own a copy of Fallout 76 on Steam can participate in our Pspsps-TS. Please note that progress from the Pspsps-TS does not carry over into the live game. The Atomic Shop is also disabled during this testing period.

To install the Pspsps-TS, open your Steam library, and install “Fallout 76 Public Test Server”.

### Public Test Server Schedule

World Pets will have two separate Pspsps-TS periods before it releases later this year.

**This first test will NOT contain all the content arriving in this update nor all the features for pets that we plan to release.**

Starting today, World Pets will be available for focused testing on pet navigation. So please travel all around Appalachia and let us know of any areas where the experience doesn’t meet your expectations. For this test, pets will never enter combat with anyone. So, you don’t have to worry about them taking damage or attacking anyone.

When the World Pets Pspsps-TS returns, we’ll kick things off with the navigation and combat being available for testing. This phase of the Pspsps-TS will include the rest of the content from this update for you all to experience and provide feedback on. So please stay tuned for all those details later this year.

Now, let’s talk a bit more about these pets.

**REMINDER: Everything in the PTS is subject to change.**

### Finding your Pets

Every C.A.M.P. Pet you currently own can be brought out into the world as a travel partner. In your Pip-Boy, you’ll find a new tab under the “Stats” menu that shows your entire catalogue of Pets. Selecting one of the pets in that menu will summon them beside you. Ready for the many adventures that await you!

Once this update releases, all pets will be able to be used in your C.A.M.P. or out in the wasteland.

#### Pet Commands

With your faithful companion beside you, you’re ready to take on the wasteland. When looking at your pet, an interact button will appear that allows you to issue one of the commands below. The emote wheel has been updated to provide a way to quickly access these commands as well.

- Stay – The pet will remain at its current location until you give the follow command, or you move to far away.
- Follow – Your pet will follow you.

When it comes to having your pet follow you around, the only places you won’t be able to take your furry friend is into a Raid or a Shelter. Pets will also not be able to swim underwater.

We’re excited for you to get your hands on these pets and tell us about your adventures with them around Appalachia.

Please remember, this is a unique slice of the World Pets feature that we hope to bring to you later this year. It does not represent the full scope of the feature, and it also does not contain the rest of the content that will be arriving alongside it.

## Gameplay Changes

### Perks

- Added Pip-Boy descriptions for the following Perks under the Perk tab
- Bloody Mess
- Pain Train
- Concentrated Fire

### Weapons

- Lever Action Rifle
- Increased clip size from 5 to 6
- The Brotherhood Recon Rifle has been replaced with a recipe for the Recon Scope in the Activity: Distant Thunder. Crafting restrictions around the Brotherhood Recon Rifle have been removed and it is now treated the same as other Hunting Rifles.
- The Fancy Single Action Revolver and Pump Action Shotgun have been removed and replaced with weapon skins for the Pump Action Shotgun and Single Action Revolver. If you have the old items, they will be converted into a normal Pump Action Shotgun or Single Action Revolver with the weapon skin applied. You can then modify the items as you please.

### Legendary Mods

- Iceman’s is now useable on all weapons.

### Workbench

- Items that are classified as “unique” now display this tag when inspected.
- Unique items can now have their Legendary Mods changed and a 4th Legendary Mod added.
- The Scrip cost to change Legendary Mods no longer increases and is now a fixed value.
- 1, 2, and 3-star require 50
- 4-star require 100
- Crafting Unique items at the workbench now requires Vault Steel.
- 3-star items require 40
- 4-star items require 80
- Increased the number of modules required to craft unique items
- 3-star items require 30
- 4-star items require 65
- Unique items have an increased Scrip cost to change Legendary Mods.
- This is 10x the base cost
- When attaching mods to an item, the replaced mod is now shown in the confirmation window. In addition, there is text to highlight if the replaced mod is not known by your character.

### Known Issue

**C.A.M.P. Building and Editing Temporarily Disabled**

C.A.M.P. Building is currently deactivated for the start of this PTS while the team investigates an issue. Players will not be able to edit, move, or place items in their C.A.M.P. in the meantime.
